abstract.p: We present two LLM-based approaches to zeroshot source-and-target belief prediction on Fact-Bank: a unified system that identifies events, sources, and belief labels in a single pass, and a hybrid approach that uses a fine-tuned De-BERTa tagger for event detection. We show that multiple open-sourced, closed-source, and reasoning-based LLMs struggle with the task. Using the hybrid approach, we achieve new state-of-the-art results on FactBank and offer a detailed error analysis. Our approach is then tested on the Italian belief corpus ModaFact.
